title: the-questions-are-the-sieve
intention: build_inspector stops being a hand-rolled gate beside a bolted-on nexus and becomes what it already is by anatomy: a learning block whose CONSTRAINING QUESTIONS ARE ITS SIEVES. Two moves. (1) A sieve's MESH is DERIVED from its own reach — computed from what it imports and opens through import_sieve's graph, never authored — and the nest orders itself by those bands. A FINDING CARRIES A DATUM AND A SCORE — the datum is what was looked at, the score is a float that means nothing alone and everything against the sieve's own mesh, which is the requirement it is relative to. Binary today: every score is 1.0 or 0.0 and every mesh is `>= 1`, so a nest of five reads [1.0, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0] = 0.0. NO THIRD VALUE ANYWHERE — a sieve that never ran because a coarser band caught is ABSENT from the report, with the stopping band named once, because 0.0 would assert 'did not catch', a claim it is not entitled to make. (2) The inspector's checks become a declared data-only block spec and run on the learning_block engine, candidates loop degenerate at one candidate (the component under inspection), the engine untouched and branchless.
why: Akien opened it as a contradiction, in his words: 'Inspector is supposed to be a learning block, which would imply it's questions need to be in a tree and not in filters/seives... unless the seives and nest were implemented in the trees?' The contradiction dissolves, and what it exposes underneath is the real defect. The anatomy (decisions/2026-08-05-a-learning-block-is-a-question-nexus-rebased) names a domain KB and constraining questions and DOES NOT SAY WHERE THEY LIVE — his words today: 'that definition does not say where they are... the questions are the rigid part, they can be in a dict... that's just part of the kb that isn't in a tree.' So a rigid dict was never disqualifying. What disqualifies build_inspector is that it does not run on the engine at all: it carries its own inspect() over a flat FILTERS dict, with nexus.py alongside as a separate growth path, so the block learns right up to the moment a check is installed and then stops. Nothing can say 'this sieve has caught nothing in forty builds.' THE LIVED SYMPTOM IS AKIEN'S, and it is the one he has now named twice: he reads the system's own gate and finds it is not built the way the system says gates are built — a check whose strictness lives in a human's head, in an assembly whose order lives in a hand-written list, inside a device that claims to be a learning block. The second symptom is quieter and worse: a hand-labeled nest goes stale silently. Edit a sieve so it reaches the network and it keeps running near the top forever, because the label still reads what it read the day it was written.
traces_to: Law 1 — the resolver is spent on the novel: an ordering re-derived by hand at every insertion, and a strictness re-decided per check, are settled answers being re-derived
Law 4 — a rule that matters is enforced by physics: 'coarse first' as prose in a charter is policy; a band computed from the sieve's own imports is the schema
Law 3 — nothing is known until measured: the mesh becomes a measured property of the code rather than an authored claim about it
Law 6 — everything has exactly one owner: a sieve owns its own mesh and nothing else; strict 1-2-3 numbering makes an insertion a write to its neighbours
decisions/2026-08-06-a-stack-of-sieves-is-a-nest — confirmed; this node is its implementation, and answers the ordering question it deliberately left open
decisions/2026-08-05-a-learning-block-is-a-question-nexus-rebased — the anatomy this node conforms build_inspector to
decisions/2026-08-05-a-check-is-worth-its-mesh — mesh as strictness; the band is its measurable half
learns-its-gates, the founding intention — a hand-set constant in a gate is a learned value stranded in a human's head

proves_green.prove_gate: code-seam's proof gate — the tester runs proofs/ and emits a VALIDATION; verdict and seal from the same hand.
proves_green.proof_gate: defect-first teeth: a fixture sieve whose reach is edited must MOVE BANDS with no other change; a fixture where a coarse band catches must yield not-applicable — never pass, never a finding — from every finer band; and an accept-everything mutant of the derivation must turn a tooth red. A derivation that cannot red is the hollow check this class refuses (Law 8).
proves_green.durability_gate: not done until proven AND durably committed (git), on the emit chokepoint rather than on anyone's memory.
proves_green.kicks_back_on: red proof — routes back to design/build at the point of creation (CP2).

falsifier.proves_red: FALSIFIER, RED by physics on any of: (1) a mesh band is AUTHORED anywhere — a field, a constant, a docstring line — rather than derived from the sieve's own code; (2) editing a sieve so it reaches further does not move its band at the next derivation; (3) a sieve in a finer band emits a score for an input a coarser band already caught — it must be ABSENT from the report, never 0.0, because 0.0 is a claim it cannot make (Law 7: a record of truth does not collapse an unanswerable question into an answer); (3b) a score appears without the mesh it is relative to, which turns a verdict back into an uninterpretable reading; (4) the nest fires one sieve, reads it, and re-fires, rather than shaking once; (5) the engine grows a build_inspector-specific branch. WRONG-INTENT TELL: if deriving reach needs per-sieve exceptions, 'reach is derivable' is falsified — stop and reconcile, do not accrete cases.
falsifier.horizon: Re-read at the first sieve whose reach the derivation cannot compute, and at child (a)'s opening band-sorting pass. If the existing checks do not separate into bands, the domain is flatter than the metaphor and this node re-enters design rather than taking a patch.

how: Refactor build_inspector from hand-rolled gate + bolted-on nexus to a learning block whose constraining questions ARE the sieve. The questions are the gate; the nexus is the question set's learning surface.
